recent_en: IJM announced its quarterly results on 26 November 2026 and declared a first interim dividend of 2 sen per share. During the same period, there were several changes in directors and board committees, and the Employees Provident Fund Board continued to file changes in its shareholdings.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
Declared a first interim dividend of 2 sen per share.
Appointed and changed several directors and committee members.
risks_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board filed multiple changes in its shareholdings between October and November.
A senior management member conducted multiple open market transactions in the company's shares between September and November.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 2,292,299,000, up 22.8% QoQ and 32.2% YoY; net income was MYR 148,352,000, up 38.4% YoY, with a net margin of 6.5%.
